author: LGR
description:
I feel like every other computer person owned one of these HP Pavilions at some point, these were everywhere in the late 90s and early 2000s! Makes sense considering it cost as low as $149 with rebates. So let's dive into the 6535 model with its 466MHz Intel Celeron and see what else is inside, what's broken or missing, and what needs repair and cleaning and such.

● Here's the video from Billy about this system:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EQiddnNX-GM
